|-- Page composition and service dependencies
|   |-- MappingPocPage({ services: MappingServices })
|   |   `-- Supplies MappingServicesContext to MappingWorkspacePage
|   |-- useMappingServices(): diagrams, canvasHistory, workspaceStorage
|   |-- The page creates CanvasWorkspace and disposes it on cleanup
|   |-- new DiagramEditCoordinator(createDiagramEditClient())
|   `-- Injected storage is used; only page-created storage is disposed here
|-- CanvasWorkspace / CanvasSession boundary
|   |-- CanvasDraft extends DraftMetadata { session: CanvasSession }
|   |-- The workspace manages session creation, replacement and disposal
|   |-- setDrafts(seed) -> new CanvasSession(..., diagrams, history) [call]
|   |-- controllers: Map<string, MappingDocumentController>
|   |   `-- This registry exposes controllers created by sessions
|   |-- CanvasSession creates a controller and subscribes to its changes
|   |-- readable(store): getState, getInitialState, subscribe
|   |   |-- Stores publish document, presentation, selection and controls
|   |   `-- geometry/status: endpointBounds, cell, version / dirty, undo, redo
|   |-- Session stores publish references; the controller manages domain state
|   |-- statusOf <- sceneKey, edgesKey, saved keys, current/saved name [data]
|   `-- copyDocument calls forkHistory and clears selection and resets chat pending flags
|-- Document and canvas contracts
|   |-- MappingGridDocument: scene, edges, sections, jumps?
|   |   `-- The scene supplies grid structure and diagram content references
|   |-- MappingCanvasState: selection, diagramViews?, display, controls
|   |-- SelectionState is responsible for membership and insertion order
|   |   |-- SelectionItem: id, displayNodeId, region?
|   |   |-- No region means the whole diagram instance is selected
|   |   |-- region: sourceContentId, sourceRevisionId?, sourceAscii, rect, selectedIds
|   |   `-- selectionCommand deduplicates regions and excludes whole/region overlap
|   `-- MappingControls stores focus, active thread and per-selection surfaces
|-- Canvas display adapter
|   |-- canvasDisplayNodes(document, canvas, version, cell, endpointBounds?)
|   |-- It derives a read-only registry from scene and display data
|   |-- CanvasDisplayNode = common metadata & (grid | floating) [type sketch]
|   |   |-- grid: diagram | group; geometry.units = 'cells'
|   |   |-- floating: FloatingBox kind; geometry.units = 'pixels'
|   |   `-- Geometry has no second writable copy in this adapter
|   |-- Grid entries combine visible bounds with expanded-tree fallback bounds
|   |-- projectDiagramContent(content, view) -> subtree visibleRow [data sketch]
|   |-- Floating placement follows grid regions, parents, conversations or storage
|   `-- drawEdge(edge, scene, diagramViews, cell, endpointBounds) [call]
|-- View components and live viewport adapter
|   |-- DraggableDiagramCanvas wraps MappingPocSelectionCanvas
|   |   |-- session={draft.session}; onUndo -> undo; onTransfer -> beginTransfer
|   |   `-- Previously mounted documents remain rendered, with inactive views hidden
|   |-- MappingDiagramExplorer receives active scene, dirty IDs and open/delete callbacks
|   |-- SourcePaneViewState manages scroll entries, cameras and notification timers
|   |   |-- bind(documentId, paneId, sourceFile, fallback?, sourceId?)
|   |   |-- captureDisplay / captureCamera sample live view data for saving
|   |   `-- Live scrolling stays outside the React display tree
|   `-- DiagramEditComposer receives diagramEdits; cleanup disposes the coordinator
|-- Search, navigation and reviewed changes
|   |-- DiagramSearchService is created with a worker factory and disposed by the page
|   |-- search.sync(searchDocuments) [call]
|   |   `-- Inputs combine settled saved revisions, visible drafts and a matching proposal
|   |-- revealSearchResult <- content.revisionId, asciiSha256 [data]
|   |   `-- Stale results are rejected before applying focus
|   |-- jumpTo(target) -> open(target.representationId), controller.nodes() [calls]
|   |-- ChangeSessionPreview supplies proposal search data and accepted-change callbacks
|   `-- openAccepted preserves newer dirty local edits when the reviewed baseline differs
|-- Project and workspace integration
|   |-- open(id) -> documentFromRevision, historyFromRevision, setDrafts [calls]
|   |-- save() -> saveMappingProjectDiagram(captured history, scene, edges) [call]
|   |   `-- Save acknowledgement updates the captured baseline
|   |-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot; schemaVersion = 3
|   |   `-- Includes histories, document views, metadata, cameras and transfers
|   |-- restore checks project identity and prunes unavailable saved documents
|   |-- new WorkspacePersistence(workspace, storage.records, projectId, viewState)
|   |-- workspaceAction -> storage.flush / storage.restore / workspace codec [calls]
|   `-- remove retires affected transfer links before syncing remaining records
`-- Agent and coordinated-edit integration
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge(descriptor, handleAgentCommand, workspace)
    |-- The descriptor lists visible drafts and their saved representation aliases
    |-- handleAgentCommand -> controller.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations) [call]
    |-- apply-diagram-revision delegates to DiagramRevisionReceiver.apply
    |   `-- Its supplied callback syncs persistence and awaits storage.flush()
    |-- transfer -> runWorkspaceTask({ type: 'transfer', source, destination, input }) [call]
    |-- Transfer input requires captured histories, selected IDs and source/destination views
    |-- publishTransfer -> await storage.save(workspace) -> installWorkspace [call order]
    `-- Workspace undo coordinates both participants when a transfer boundary is found
